target_description: NWS heat index 24 hours ahead, derived from historical temperature and relative humidity
baseline_rule: Predicted heat index at t+24h equals the calculated heat index at time t
success_rule: ML model test MAE must be lower than the predeclared baseline test MAE
uncertainty_plan: 90 percent split-conformal interval using calibration-period absolute errors
limitations: Target is a weather-derived heat index, not observed illness
Heat index does not fully represent direct-sun worksite exposure
Historical ERA5 is reanalysis, not archived issued forecasts
Operational use requires current inputs available at issue time
